name: Itoshii Kanojo no Mamorikata
source:
Yuuto enrolled in a military school in order to fulfill a childhood promise with Yui. But when he met her again, she demanded to know why he came there. He realized that her smile had disappeared. This is because their class is ridiculed for being weaker than other classes. Their classroom is not well furnished and his bed is more like a table. Their teacher announces that there will be a battle in which the rewards will be a proper desk and chairs… and an air conditioner as well! Yuuto decides to help their class win this battle and bring a smile back to Yui’s face.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/05/18/may-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
松井悠人为了兑现与天城结衣儿时的约定，进入了一所军事学校。然而，久别重逢时，结衣质问他为何来到这里，悠人也发现她脸上的笑容早已消失。

原来，他们的班级因为比其他班级弱小而饱受嘲笑。教室设施简陋，悠人的床甚至更像一张桌子。教师宣布即将举行一场对战，胜利者的奖励是像样的桌椅，甚至还有空调！悠人决定帮助班级赢得这场对战，让笑容重新回到结衣脸上。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/05/18/may-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
